It's a special moment for the couple to show their respect and gratitude to their elders, and for the elders to feel valued and appreciated. Shortening the ceremony might have rushed the experience and diminished its impact. It's a memorable and meaningful experience that will likely be cherished by all involved. Plus, the anticipation and build-up to the banquet might have even added to the excitement and expectation of the celebration to come! So, I think keeping the tradition as it was, was the right decision.
